basics.name: Alexander Kurakin
basics.label: Game Systems Engineer | Principal Software Engineer
basics.summary: Principal Software Engineer with over a decade of professional experience in high-reliability systems, translating enterprise engineering into professional game development. Expert in C# architecture, Unity middleware integration, and scalable gameplay systems.

work.name: Oracle (NetSuite)
work.summary: Leveraging high-level engineering expertise to drive reliability, performance, and architectural standards across distributed systems.
highlights: Performance optimization: expertly diagnosed and resolved bottlenecks in high-load systems using advanced tracing. Applied rigorous optimization strategies to legacy codebases, achieving performance parity across platforms.

Tooling and automation: led the development of internal diagnostic tools and automated replay frameworks to stabilize legacy pipelines, significantly reducing debugging time for the wider engineering team.
Engineering leadership: mentored senior engineers and directed cross-functional initiatives. Championed strict version control (Perforce/Git) and defensive programming standards.

work.name: Integro technologies / Seertech Solutions
work.summary: Full-stack development involving system design, legacy modernization, and cross-stack integration.
highlights: Systems architecture: led the modernization of critical legacy modules for major enterprise clients, enforcing separation of concerns and improving system stability.
Cross-language integration: engineered complex data pipelines involving JSON processing and RESTful APIs. Debugged C# and Java interoperability issues to ensure seamless data flow.
Technical management: promoted to Team Lead within 6 months to oversee project delivery, conduct technical interviews, and define architectural standards.
